current_concerns.primary_problems: My son's death, grief, sadness, and I cannot concentrate.
current_concerns.goals: To cope with the loss and return to functioning.

past_psychiatric_history.assessment_details: Followed by Dr. Laura Bennett, psychiatrist, during two depressive episodes in 1998 and 2003.
past_psychiatric_history.previous_diagnoses: Depression, with two prior episodes in his 30s.
past_psychiatric_history.self_harm_details: No history of self-harm or suicide attempts. Currently sometimes feels he would be better off dead, without a plan or intent to act; reports he can stay safe right now.
past_psychiatric_history.previous_therapies: Individual psychotherapy in 1998, about 16 weekly sessions; no other psychotherapy or counseling.
past_psychiatric_history.previous_treatments: Sertraline 100 mg daily during two prior depressive episodes in his 30s for about 18 months; worked well, with no remembered side effects.

medications.past_medication_details: Sertraline 100 mg daily during two prior depressive episodes in his 30s, taken for about 18 months; worked well and no remembered side effects.

medical_history.surgical_history: No surgeries or major medical procedures.

family_psychiatric_history.family_psychiatric_history_details: Parents had depression; son died by suicide.

education_employment_legal_history.employment_history: Owner and managing director of Quinn Import Services since 2004.
